question: Should OpenClaw land the Google Live `parameters` field switch for all realtime tools after resolving the current conflict, or require schema normalization or another billed Live smoke first?
rationale: The source path and Google SDK contract support the fix, but the field switch affects all Google realtime custom tools and maintainers must own that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Resolve conflict and land field switch
options.body: Keep current-main changelog content, rerun exact-head gates, and merge after accepting the bounded custom-schema compatibility risk.

options.title: Normalize schemas first
options.body: Add an explicit OpenAPI-compatible schema normalization layer before merge to lower risk for unusual realtime tool schemas.

options.title: Pause for paid Live smoke
options.body: Wait for a maintainer-owned Gemini Live tool-call smoke if inherited redacted logs are not enough proof for the provider-wide switch.

recommendation.title: Resolve conflict and land field switch
recommendation.body: Keep current-main changelog content, rerun exact-head gates, and merge after accepting the bounded custom-schema compatibility risk.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the replacement branch and is the current-main author of the Google realtime provider implementation under review.
